notes.title: Version 0.6
notes.content:
v. 0.6


Updates:
-New map on a new planet.
-4 new monsters: horn tiger, masked ghost, small ghost, boar demon.
-Extended the Zoo.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40640825/b5919767aaac55e06c12d03193a25ea70eeac3ec.png[/img]

Changes:
-Higher rewards for beating a map.
-No more arrows and energy as free start resource.

-Fixed crash when starting the tutorial map.
-Laser bullets missed target at close distance.

notes.title: Version 0.55
notes.content:
v. 0.55


Updates:
-new game mechanic “taming”:
You can use certain monsters from your zoo as support units.
Tamable monsters so far: wolf, alpha wolf, pachycephalo.
Tamed monsters can’t be controlled directly, but you can order them to 
another character’s place by clicking the dog whistle button in the character menu.

-New status symbols for characters: Hunger, broken weapon, no arrows, no energy:
-New enemy hp bar (appears when hp is less than 100%).
-New defence structure hp bar (appears when hp is less than 100%).


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40640825/57e614730347a8f28af2c2373b8ecf9e32bfca52.png[/img]

UI:
-Added a timer which shows the seconds till the next wave of monsters appears.
-Changed some of the background images of some menus.
-New monster information for monsters in the zoo.

Changes:
-Changed the building images in the hub menu.

notes.title: Update v.0513
notes.content:
v. 0.513

-Characters will automatically start eating at a campfire after building it.

-Fixed when loading the game characters returned to their previous job instead of their current job when the according building was destroyed before they arrived there.

Updates:
-Added a custom cursor to the game.

notes.title: Monsters per second entered early access!
notes.content:
Monsters per second just entered early access!

I want to use this opportunity to tell you more about the game in its current state and about the early access plans.

Now there are 10 maps available (5 for each planet).
Each planet is inhabited by its own unique monsters.
You can buy new weapons and unlock new buildings to be prepared for a steadily increasing difficulty.

Here is a rough plan for the big updates during the early access phase.

-A new major game mechanic
-A new planet with 5 more maps and more monsters
(One map per update)
-Bonus “high score” map 
The first big update is planned for the beginning of January 2022.

Smaller patches will be released whenever needed.

Feel free to contact me for feedback, questions or other issues.
Best regards
ALTILLRA

notes.title: A Demo of Monsters per second will be released during Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Monsters per second will release a Demo version from Oct 1,2021 @ 10:00 am Pacific time – Oct7.
It will include the Tutorial and the first map with an adjusted “hard” difficulty.

Note: The final version of the game may be different from the Demo version since it is still in development.

Have fun and a great Steam Next Fest!
Altillra
